title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Colorado School of Mines
description: Build an under-21-safe late-night ritual board. Every card needs a currently verifiable destination, a direct source supporting late availability, and a conservative explanation of why it matters near this campus. Do not invent student habits, signature orders, popularity, or current hours. Bars and 21+-only venues are prohibited.

cards.title: Elements
cards.subtitle: Ben Parker Student Center
cards.notes: Visit this on-campus convenience store for late-night snacks, beverages, and a F'real milkshake machine. It serves as a primary hub for students studying in the student center.
cards.short_summary: Elements is a campus convenience store in the Ben Parker Student Center offering snacks and milkshakes until 10:00 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Elements is open until 10:00 PM Monday through Thursday during the regular academic semester.
cards.source_title: Elements - Colorado School of Mines Dining
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM Monday-Thursday during regular semester hours.

cards.title: Qdoba Mexican Eats
cards.subtitle: Ben Parker Student Center
cards.notes: Head to the Periodic Table food court for late-night burritos and bowls. It is one of the few on-campus hot food options available after standard dinner hours.
cards.short_summary: Qdoba Mexican Eats is an on-campus retail dining option located in the Ben Parker Student Center food court.
cards.evidence_claim: Qdoba at the Periodic Table is open until 10:00 PM Monday through Thursday.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation - Colorado School of Mines Dining
cards.access_notes: Retail hours extend to 10:00 PM Monday-Thursday.

cards.title: Woody's Wood-Fired Pizza
cards.subtitle: Washington Avenue
cards.notes: Stop by this Golden staple for wood-fired pizza and wings. The dining room remains open until 11:00 PM daily, making it a popular off-campus gathering spot.
cards.short_summary: Woody's Wood-Fired Pizza is a long-standing local restaurant in downtown Golden known for its pizza buffet and late hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Woody's Wood-Fired Pizza is open every day from 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Woody's Wood-Fired Pizza Restaurant - Golden, Colorado
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM daily for dine-in service.

cards.title: Safeway
cards.subtitle: Jackson Street
cards.notes: Walk to this grocery store near campus for late-night supplies or deli items. It is a frequent stop for students living in nearby residence halls or apartments.
cards.short_summary: Safeway is a full-service grocery store located within walking distance of the Colorado School of Mines campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Safeway at 1701 Jackson St in Golden is open until 11:00 PM daily.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: South Golden Road
cards.notes: Drive to South Golden Road for late-night tacos and burritos. The drive-thru remains open well past midnight, serving as a reliable option for late study sessions.
cards.short_summary: Taco Bell is a fast-food restaurant offering late-night drive-thru service near the Mines campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 17764 S Golden Rd is open until 3:00 AM on Thursdays and 4:00 AM on Fridays.

cards.subtitle: South Golden Road

cards.title: Moonlight Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Elm Hall
cards.notes: Attend this semesterly tradition during finals week for free late-night breakfast. It is a major campus event designed to provide a study break for all students.
cards.short_summary: Moonlight Breakfast is a recurring late-night event at Mines Market offering free food to students during finals.
cards.evidence_claim: Mines Market hosts Moonlight Breakfast from 8:00 PM to 9:30 PM during finals week, providing free meals to students with a Blaster Card.
cards.source_title: Moonlight Breakfast 2026 - Mines Daily Blast System
cards.access_notes: Event typically held from 8:00 PM to 9:30 PM; requires Blaster Card for entry.
